evidence.evidence_summary: The May 21 event involved three English subsidiaries entering administration while the NYSE parent ticker remained CZOO; CZOOF was the later OTC identity and the Cayman parent did not enter voluntary winding up until July 2.

Cazoo Holdings Limited, Cazoo Ltd and Cazoo Properties Limited entered UK administration and joint administrators were appointed; the Cayman parent had only begun steps toward a separate voluntary winding up.
NYSE immediately suspended CZOO on May 21, commenced delisting proceedings under Section 802.01D, and the issuer declined to appeal while expecting OTC Pink trading.
The issuer states that its Class A ordinary shares were finally delisted from NYSE effective June 3, 2024 and were then trading on OTC Pink.

Shareholders placed the Cayman parent into voluntary winding up because it was unable to pay its debts, liquidators were appointed, directors resigned, transfers closed and no shareholder proceeds were expected; final dissolution remained future work.
